'''2011 US Nationals Geoff Dearing DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Geoff Dearing]] at [[2011 US Nationals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V) / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe (V)|VB4-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi-pre.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Hunt Down (V)
* '''Username:''' gdearing
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
